name: Vocation
overview: Scripture reveals that vocation is rooted in God's sovereign calling and purpose for His people, as He has planned an expected and hopeful future for them (Jeremiah 29:11). Christ's invitation to follow Him includes a divine appointment to fruitful service, transforming believers into instruments for advancing the gospel (Mark 1:17; John 15:16). This calling is both personal and purposeful, involving being chosen by Christ to bear lasting fruit and fulfill the Great Commission (Matthew 28:16; Matthew 22:14; John 15:16). Furthermore, the Spirit empowers believers to minister healing, deliverance, and restoration, reflecting the mission Jesus was anointed to carry out (Luke 4:18).
